## RWA — DAILY 2026-11-13

## ÉTAT DU SECTEUR
Le TVL de la catégorie RWA de DefiLlama s'élève à **3,52 Md$** (190 protocoles DeFi, relevé du 2026-11-13 12:40 UTC), en baisse de **-5,66%** sur 7 jours, mais en hausse de **+0,19%** sur les dernières 24 heures. Cela se traduit par la position dominante de xStocks dans le tableau des émetteurs (4,53 Md$).

L'entrée de banques systémiques comme Deutsche Bank dans la garde d'actifs numériques (CoinTelegraph) confirme que la tokenisation est devenue un vecteur d'efficacité opérationnelle pour les institutions. Dans un régime de liquidité "crypto" globale contrainte, les flux structurels proviennent de l'arbitrage réglementaire et de la recherche de rendement par les acteurs traditionnels, plutôt que de l'expansion monétaire native.

## ROBINHOOD CHAIN — DAILY 2026-11-14

## ÉTAT ON-CHAIN
Chain TVL stands at $1.028B, reflecting a -0.7% daily decline and a consistent downward trajectory over the last 14 days from a ~$1.09B peak (chain_tvl_history). Capital concentration remains elevated, with the top 5 protocols controlling ~65% of TVL. Morpho Blue maintains dominance in the lending sector, commanding ~58% of total supply TVL ($599.8M) and ~63% of borrowed USD ($463.8M). This skew indicates that current value is heavily reliant on initial launch incentives and credit demand rather than diversified organic activity. Steakhouse Financial follows as the second-largest protocol by TVL ($536M), underscoring the role of risk curation in managing the concentrated capital.

## CATALYSEURS
*   **Institutional Tokenization Race:** Robinhood's backing of the OKX-ICE tokenized stock venue (70+ assets) serves as the primary on-chain driver, incentivizing deposit flows to access these regulated instruments (CoinDesk). This is contextualized by competitive pressure from the NYSE selecting Avalanche for tokenized stock settlement and the DTCC's planned 2027 integration with Solana, forcing Robinhood Chain to prove liquidity depth to retain institutional mindshare.
*   **Regulatory Friction:** The Louisiana lawsuit against Robinhood and Kalshi regarding prediction markets introduces a headline risk that may be dampening risk-on sentiment, contributing to the slow bleed in TVL (The Block). This highlights the fragility of the "regulated" narrative in the face of state-level enforcement actions.
*   **Launch Incentive Decay:** The persistent -2% to -3% daily drawdowns over the last week suggest that the initial "new chain" liquidity mining premium is wearing off, exposing the underlying demand without artificial yield support.

## VALUE ACCRUAL
Robinhood Chain possesses no native token; value accrual is strictly external to the protocol layer. Based on the measured token capture table:
*   **Spark (SPK):** Captures 55.4% of protocol revenue.
*   **Lighter (LIT):** Captures 78.1% of protocol revenue.
*   **Uniswap (UNI):** Captures 100.0% of protocol revenue.
*   **Morpho (MORPHO):** Value accrual is currently "captation non mesuree" (revenue unknown), despite its dominance in TVL.

## LECTURE RÉGIME
In a down-cycle characterized by scarce fresh capital and global regulatory tightening (MiCA, Taiwan crypto law, US GENIUS Act), Robinhood Chain represents a structural experiment in "compliance-native" DeFi. The chain attempts to bridge the gap between institutional capital requirements and on-chain liquidity. However, the current TVL trajectory suggests that in a risk-off environment, capital is not sticky enough to remain on a regulated L2 without superior yield or unique utility. The competitive landscape (Avalanche/Solana institutional moves) implies that Robinhood Chain cannot rely solely on its broker brand; it must demonstrate superior capital efficiency or deeper liquidity for tokenized equities to secure long-term structural flows.

## À SURVEILLER
*   **Morpho Borrow Velocity:** Monitor if the ~63% borrowing share translates into sustainable interest income or if liquidations will trigger a cascade given the concentration risk.
*   **OKX-ICE Asset Expansion:** Track the listing of new tokenized stocks on OKX-ICE and the immediate correlation with TVL inflows into Robinhood Chain protocols.
*   **Regulatory Litigation:** Watch for developments in the Louisiana lawsuit, as an adverse ruling could force a rapid de-risking by institutional participants.

Maple Finance: REVISE - Multiple compression to 1.35x (56% discount) improves value proposition despite fee decline; thesis contingent on base stabilization and fee resolution.
Meteora: REVISE - Fee growth deceleration to 49.18% reduces growth momentum, while multiple at 0.69x maintains 71% discount; capture activation remains the primary trigger.
Orca: REVISE - Fee growth acceleration to 5.04% supports value thesis alongside 9.2% capture; multiple compression to 1.16x widens discount to 50%.

Maple Finance: TVL base declines >15% quarter-over-quarter or fees remain unresolved for 30 consecutive days.
Meteora: Fee growth turns negative (<-10%) for 14 consecutive days or capture remains 0% for 30 consecutive days.
Orca: Fee growth turns negative (<-10%) for 14 consecutive days or capture falls below 5%.

v.note_evaluation: La condition est decoupee sur ses « ou » et CHAQUE membre porte ses propres nombres. La clause de SEUIL se note quand on a la valeur ; la clause de DUREE se note quand la condition nomme une base dont on possede la serie quotidienne — sinon elle reste NON EVALUABLE et le dit, sans repli sur une autre base. Une clause de PERSISTANCE (« reste a X % pendant N jours ») n'est jamais notee : on a la capture du jour, pas son historique — on ecrit seulement si le niveau de declenchement est atteint. La capture vient du board et annualise 24 h : un verdict proche du seuil est marque fragile. Un seuil de 7 baisses consecutives est rare mais pas hors d'atteinte : mesure sur 365 jours, jamais atteint sur le volume d'Orca ni de Raydium (max 6), atteint une fois sur la TVL de Spark (7) et de Lista DAO (8).
v.note: 193 verdicts sur 86 briefs redigés, du 2026-07-10 au 2026-11-14. Les conditions d'invalidation sont affichées AVEC leur date de pose — elles ne sont PAS notées : traduire une phrase libre en prédicat puis la confronter à une série qu'on n'a pas toujours produirait un verdict fabriqué, ce qui serait pire que pas de verdict.

externe.note: Chaque clause est traduite en predicat 0-LLM et notee sur des series publiques. La DEFINITION utilisee accompagne chaque verdict. Series normalisees par jour UTC, jour courant exclu. Une clause de duree en jours compte a partir du jour de pose de la condition. Aucun chiffre du brief n'est repris : le 25/09, son « fee growth » s'est revele etre une variation d'UN jour, pas d'une semaine.
